findings.title: Add coverage for the architecture aggregate rule
findings.description: Task 12 tests `plan-status-vs-entries`, but the slice design’s success criteria also name `arch-status-vs-plans`. The walkthrough and other tasks do not test that rule with an all-checked-or-deprecated plan, so its stated behavior is not verified. Extend the ConsistencyChecker tests to cover the architecture rule as well.

findings.title: Verify the unindexed entry’s fallback index and description
findings.description: Task 5 checks the unindexed entry’s status, `isChecked`, and `indexSource`, but not its actual fallback index, name, or parsed rationale. The design requires the unindexed form to parse equivalently, including the description. Assert those values so a dropped or incorrectly parsed description or fallback index cannot pass.

findings.title: The CLI test does not verify the displayed deprecated label
findings.description: Task 10 asserts JSON `status: 'deprecated'` and `isNext: false`, but the success criterion says `cf list slices` renders the existing `⊘ deprecated` display. JSON status does not verify the table rendering. Add an assertion against the table output, or otherwise explicitly verify that rendered label.

findings.title: Remove the redundant `derivedStatus` initializer change
findings.description: Task 9’s extra initializer edit is justified as a fallback when `detectDocuments` throws. In the current `sliceListAction`, that failure is caught and sets `derivedStatus` to `'degraded'`; the initializer is not used for that path. The required plan-line signal belongs in the `deriveEntryStatus()` call. Drop the initializer edit and its inaccurate justification to keep the task within the slice’s stated scope.

findings.title: Keep the WorkflowNavigator test next to its implementation task
findings.description: Task 8 changes `WorkflowNavigator.resolveEntryStatus`, but its direct regression test is task 11, after the CLI implementation and integration test. Move task 11 directly after task 8 so that this implementation is tested at its working point; it does not depend on the CLI tasks.

findings.title: Merge the three small parser implementation tasks
findings.description: Tasks 2–4 make small, related edits to the same parser and `parseSlicePlan()` flow: accept `~`, assign deprecated status, and update the aggregate count. They are not independently tested or useful working points; task 5 tests them together. Merge them into one parser implementation task followed immediately by task 5.
